svg.title: Skyline Works Studio bath and brush portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional pet grooming portfolio concept for Skyline Works Studio, showing a calm mixed-breed dog after a professional bath and brush. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
